title: Rules, indexes, deletion list
description: Action: deny writes in the cutover release (allowlisted in allowlist.json by DNI-490), remove in the release after (DNI-491: the rules matches and indexes are gone and the allowlist is empty). The entries stay pending only so tool/check_retired_test_references.dart lets the rules and deletion tests name the retired paths they prove are default-denied; CI's --enforce treats them as retired, so any hit in their scope fails.
